due_when.clears_when: 79 unprovable CI guards have either: (a) --self-test entry added with planted-defect proof, (b) pytest coverage migrated to guard_selftests.py, or (c) documented reason why testing is not possible

what: 79 of 95 CI guards in run_guards.py have NO proven failure-path coverage. 47 lack any test at all; 34 rely on pytest-only (unproven); 9 have zero failure-path evidence anywhere. A guard that passes on a clean tree is not proven to catch the defect it exists for. AUDIT FINDING: audit-sa-2026-09-29 lane E75 (AUD-6) confirmed via python3 scripts/ci/check_guard_selftest_coverage.py that 63/106 guards have proven coverage (59.4%), leaving 43 unproven in the broader pool and 79 unproven in run_guards.py's ~95 registered guards. Tier-2 finding: data-backed, proposed fix documented in AUD-6.md, awaiting operator scope decision on remediation priority.
